Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. # - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.

payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Are the scene's surfaces and tonal values represented pervasively in a pencil-drawn shading style?
node.criteria: Pass if tonal modeling across the principal objects and large surrounding surfaces is pervasively conveyed by pencil-like shading, including directional strokes, hatching, graphite-like rubbed tones or mark-based texture following form. Fail if substantial surfaces retain photographic tonal modeling, realistic specular reflections or photographic material textures merely covered by grain. Reduced saturation, softened contrast and a uniform texture overlay alone do not satisfy this condition. Retained patterns are not themselves disqualifying; evaluate whether their rendering and surrounding tones are pencil-drawn rather than photographic. Use unknown only when the available visual evidence cannot establish the shading style.
node.binding: Compare the supplied SOURCE and EDITED images against the requested pencil-drawing transformation. Inspect tonal rendering across the food, glassware and pitcher, as well as the large tabletop, tablecloth and surrounding background areas. Distinguish form-following pencil marks or graphite-like tonal rendering from retained photographic gradients, reflections, woven textures and printed patterns under an overlay. Assess surface interiors independently of contour linework.

node_traces.evidence: The edit is desaturated and softened, with a fine uniform grain and some softened outlines, but substantial surfaces still show photographic tonal gradients and material detail. The food retains smooth highlights and realistic shading, the glassware and pitcher retain reflective gradients, and the tablecloth and background retain their photographic woven and printed textures. There is little pervasive form-following hatching or pencil-like mark-based shading across these surfaces.

Keep unrelated changes from counting, and reserve unknown for inadequate visual evidence. The trace is valid and has no transport, schema, or dependency failure; the mismatch is criterion/label granularity, not evidence that the edit is complete."}
